- Clarify your vulnerability management SLAs: what are your SLA windows for critical/high/medium findings (time-to-remediate or time-to-mitigate)? Do you track metrics and report them?

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pen test & vuln questions from FintechCo — need artifacts + guidance

Thanks — quick summary below we can send to FintechCo and attach the redacted report: 

1) Pen test artifacts we can share: 
- Executive summary + full findings (redacted for customer-identifying data). See attachment: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf.
- Scope page (environments in-scope: hosted API, control plane; excludes customer-managed private deployments).
- Date of test: 2025-11-12 to 2025-11-14.

2) Vulnerability management & SLA (our standard):
- Critical: initial triage within 24 hours, mitigation or compensating control within 7 business days (or emergency hotfix), permanent remediation tracked to completion (target 30 days).
- High: initial triage within 48 hours, remediation target 30 days.
- Medium: triage within 5 business days, remediation target 90 days.
- All findings tracked in our internal ticketing system; we provide aggregated monthly metrics to internal ops and on request to customers under appropriate NDAs.

3) Scanning cadence:
- External network & web app scans: weekly automated scans + quarterly authenticated app scans by 3rd-party scanner.
- Internal infra scans: weekly vulnerability scans on prod infra; nightly container image SCA in CI.
- Periodic 3rd-party pentests: annual + on major releases (we completed 2025 engagement as above).

4) Disclosure & program:
- Coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy in place (see Vuln_Disclosure_Guidance.docx). We operate a triage queue and publish a responsible disclosure process; we do not currently run a public bug bounty but engage trusted partners and private bounties for high-impact programs.

5) Additional notes:
- SOC 2 Type II: report available under NDA; audit period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
- If customer needs unredacted artifacts for procurement, we require an executed NDA or MSSP data sharing agreement.

I’ll attach the redacted summary and the disclosure guidance doc. Let me know if we should include ticket exports or scan logs (those are internal but can be provided under stricter NDA).

—Rishi
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
